name: On-the-fly pre-shading
definition: A fast technique to pre-shade the volume on the fly and then slice and composite an RGB volume to obtain an image with shading effects.
summary: On-the-fly pre-shading is a fast technique that computes shading dynamically during slicing and stores it in a pre-shaded RGB volume, distinguishing it from methods that cache shading or accumulate it during compositing.
